a2007d319b1d8e66.description: Role Overview: We are seeking a skilled Jira Administrator to join our team in Riyadh, KSA. The Jira Administrator will be responsible for the configuration, management, and support of the Jira platform, enabling seamless collaboration and project tracking across departments. The ideal candidate will have deep experience with Jira administration, a strong understanding of Atlassian products, and the ability to implement and optimize workflows to enhance team productivity. Key Responsibilities: Administer and configure Jira (Cloud/Server/Data Center) and Jira Service Management projects. Manage Jira users, groups, permissions, and security schemes. Create, modify, and maintain workflows, custom fields, screens, and dashboards. Administer and support Confluence spaces, permissions, and content structure. Manage Jira add-ons and integrations to extend functionality and improve efficiency. Provide guidance and support to teams on best practices for using Jira and Confluence. Troubleshoot issues, optimize performance, and implement upgrades or patches as required. Develop and deliver training materials, user guides, and documentation for Jira and Confluence users. Collaborate with IT, project management, and business teams to ensure Jira aligns with organizational needs. Proven experience as a Jira Administrator, including Jira Service Management. Strong knowledge of Jira workflows, schemes, fields, permissions, and project configurations. Experience with Jira add-ons/plugins and their administration. Proficient in Confluence administration and integration with Jira. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot system issues. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus. Preferred Qualifications: Atlassian Certified Jira Administrator (ACP-100 or ACP-600). Experience with scripting (e.g., Jira Automation, ScriptRunner). Experience in managing large-scale Jira instances. Medical insurance. Flight tickets.

a268c209c6a989eb.company_name: Qiddiya Investment Company | شركة قدية الاستثمارية
a268c209c6a989eb.description: Role Overview Qiddiya | القدية is seeking a Media Facade Engineer to contribute to the design, coordination, construction, and commissioning of integrated LED display systems and media facade solutions for the Prince Mohammed bin Salman Stadium. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary liaison between LED manufacturers, facade contractors, architects, and other project disciplines throughout design development, construction, and commissioning phases. Support the planning and delivery of multidisciplinary engineering and design workshops. Participate in drawing reviews and approval processes across facade, structural, electrical, IT, and AV disciplines. Assist with regulatory approvals, inspections, material reviews, and testing activities. Coordinate with the Management Contractor and project teams to support site activities involving facade fabricators, specialist contractors, and structural engineers. Ensure successful integration of media facade systems, including mounting structures, cabling pathways, power distribution, and data infrastructure. Support the testing, commissioning, and handover of complex media distribution and content management systems. Facilitate communication between contractors, consultants, vendors, and client stakeholders. Assist in the preparation and management of project documentation, training programs, and operational readiness activities. Monitor progress and identify potential coordination issues, supporting timely resolution across disciplines. Participate in international workshops, factory inspections, and material reviews as required. Required Experience and Skills A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required. Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project environments and manage multiple interfaces simultaneously. Work Environment and Travel The role involves working within complex project environments, requiring coordination across various disciplines and stakeholders. The successful candidate must have the willingness and ability to travel internationally for design workshops, factory inspections, and material testing activities as needed.

a2690f9fef7a5b54.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مها الفلا للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تسليم الطلبات بكفاءة ودقة، مع الالتزام بإجراءات العمل المعتمدة ومعايير خدمة العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة الطلبات الواردة عبر تطبيق المندوب وقبول الطلبات المناسبة وفقًا لآلية العمل المعتمدة. التحقق من تفاصيل الطلب، بما في ذلك مواقع الاستلام والتسليم، قبل بدء عملية التوصيل. استلام الطلب من المتجر، والتأكد من مطابقته لبيانات الطلب، والمحافظة عليه أثناء النقل. التواصل الفعال والواضح مع العميل والمتجر عند الضرورة، وإبلاغهما بأي تأخير أو مشكلة قد تطرأ. تسليم الطلب للعميل وتحديث حالته في التطبيق فور إتمام عملية التوصيل. الالتزام بقواعد المرور والأنظمة، والمحافظة على نظافة المركبة وجاهزيتها للعمل. التعامل مع المبالغ والمدفوعات وفق الإجراءات المالية المعتمدة، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات مالية. رفع المشكلات والشكاوى إلى المشرف المباشر ومتابعتها لضمان حلها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على استخدام التطبيقات الذكية لإدارة الطلبات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع العملاء والمتاجر. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالمواعيد والتعامل المباشر مع العملاء والمتاجر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مؤسسة مها الفلا للتجارة.

a294c69547e85a22.description: About the Role Namaa Partners is seeking an Executive Assistant to provide support to its principals. This is a full-time, remote position based anywhere in Saudi Arabia, with a focus on supporting operations in Jiddah, Makkah, and Riyadh. The role involves managing local arrangements, meetings, and documentation for principals who travel to Riyadh several times a quarter. Key Responsibilities Schedule meetings with client boards, executives, and family offices across various time zones. Arrange travel, accommodation, visas, and meeting rooms for principals visiting Saudi Arabia. Prepare meeting packs and take notes during client meetings. Manage incoming correspondence and follow up on open actions. Maintain current contact lists, files, and the engagement calendar. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a remote position, allowing you to work from home anywhere in Saudi Arabia. Given that Namaa Partners' principals are based in Oklahoma City, which is eight to nine hours behind Riyadh, some calls will occur in your late afternoon. The salary for this position is paid monthly in Saudi riyals. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a management consulting firm based in Oklahoma City. The firm advises corporate groups, family enterprises, and their boards on matters of strategy, governance, and operating performance.

a2e27bb705c5a0dc.description: The Senior PGA Teaching Professional is the most senior coach at Qiddiya Golf during Phase 1 and the guardian of the club’s instructional standard, delivering bespoke, world-class coaching to members, guests, juniors and aspiring elite players. The role leads the Golf Academy’s day-to-day programme, mentors the Teaching Professionals, and owns the quality, consistency and commercial performance of every lesson, clinic and academy offering. The incumbent is an accomplished, technology-fluent coach and a natural mentor, who can inspire a first-time golfer and refine a scratch player with equal grace. Responsibilities This position exists to establish Qiddiya Golf as the Kingdom’s benchmark for golf instruction from the very first day of operation. Until the permanent clubhouse opens in 2028 and a Director of Instruction is appointed, the Senior PGA Teaching Professional carries the instructional leadership of the club: designing and delivering the coaching curriculum, setting the lesson standard, building player pathways, and ensuring that every guest leaves the practice tee more confident, more capable and eager to return. The role combines a substantial personal coaching load with day-to-day leadership of the teaching team, but does not hold the full strategic, multi-venue or departmental budget accountability that will belong to the Head of Golf. The Senior PGA Teaching Professional works closely with the Golf Operations Manager / Head of Golf and Golf Operations Supervisor on range and simulator logistics, with Retail on custom fitting and equipment sales, with Events Team and sales on academy programmes/packages, and with Golf Saudi and the Saudi Golf Federation on junior, women’s and national player development initiatives aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. Premium Instruction & Player Development • Deliver a full weekly schedule of private lessons, playing lessons, short-game sessions and on-course coaching — tailored to each player’s goals, ability and physical profile. • Coach the club’s most discerning clientele, including VIPs, low-handicap golfers and visiting dignitaries, with the discretion and polish of a 5-star host. • Build individual development plans for regular students, recording goals, swing data, practice plans and progress in the academy’s student-management platform. • Lead high-performance coaching for elite juniors and aspiring amateur players, preparing them for national, regional and international competition. Golf Academy Programme Leadership (Phase 1) • Design, launch and continually refine the academy curriculum — beginner pathways, ladies’ programmes, junior academy levels, short-game schools and performance squads. • Manage the daily coaching calendar and booking flow, ensuring lesson capacity is aligned with demand, tee-sheet activity and practice-area availability. • Set and audit the club’s “Qiddiya Coaching Standard”: lesson structure, communication style, follow-up, punctuality and presentation of the teaching bays. • Develop academy packages, golf schools and corporate golf clinics in partnership with Sales and Events. Coaching Team Leadership & Mentoring • Lead, mentor and evaluate the PGA Teaching Professionals and Assistant Professionals, conducting regular lesson observations and constructive feedback sessions. • Run internal coaching workshops and continuing professional development, ensuring a consistent instructional philosophy across the team. • Support the Golf Academy’s Saudi national development by working with the Golf Saudi Academy Team. Mentoring Saudi PGA trainees and assistant coaches towards full professional qualification if and when required. • Contribute to recruitment, onboarding and rostering of the coaching team in partnership with the Head of Golf and Human Resources. Technology & Performance Analysis • Act as the club’s lead specialist for launch monitors, 3D motion capture, pressure plates, putting analysis and video systems — translating data into clear, simple guidance for every player. • Ensure the teaching studio/simulators and range technology is calibrated, maintained and presented to an immaculate standard at all times. • Conduct custom club-fitting sessions in partnership with Retail, recommending equipment that genuinely improves each player’s game. • Integrate fitness and mobility screening (e.g. TPI) into player assessments, liaising with external physiotherapy or performance specialists where appropriate. Commercial Performance & Guest Experience • Deliver against agreed academy revenue, lesson utilisation and student-retention targets, reporting monthly performance to the Head of Golf. • Convert lesson students into repeat clients, academy members and fittings through outstanding service and thoughtful follow-up. • Monitor guest feedback and lesson satisfaction scores, resolving any concerns personally and promptly. • Contribute to the academy budget, pricing proposals and product mix, and recommend investment in coaching technology and practice-facility enhancements. Junior, Community & National Development • Lead the junior academy, including safeguarding compliance, parent communication and structured progression from introduction to competitive golf. • Champion the growth of women’s and family golf through welcoming, culturally considerate programmes. • Collaborate with Golf Saudi and the Saudi Golf Federation on grassroots, school and talent-identification initiatives hosted at Qiddiya. • Support club competitions, pro-ams, and tournament events with clinics, rules guidance and on-course presence. Transition to the Permanent Clubhouse (2028) • Document academy processes, curricula, student records and performance data so that a seamless handover can be made to the incoming Director of Instruction if and when required. • Provide practical input into the design and specification of the permanent academy, teaching studios and practice facilities. Is expected to undertake any additional duties or responsibilities that may reasonably be required to support the wider objectives and operational needs of the organisation. Core Competencies • Bespoke Coaching Mastery: Reads each player quickly and adapts language, method and pace to individual learning styles, from complete beginners to tour-calibre amateurs. • Luxury Service Mindset: Delivers every lesson as a 5-star experience: punctual, immaculately presented, discreet and attentive to the smallest detail. • Mentorship & Leadership: Raises the standard of the whole coaching team through example, observation and generous, constructive feedback. • Communication & Cultural Intelligence: Explains complex technical concepts simply and builds warm, respectful relationships with Saudi and international clients alike. • Commercial Awareness: Understands lesson utilisation, retention and yield, and naturally identifies opportunities for academy growth. • Attention to Detail: Notices the smallest flaw in a swing, a data set or a teaching bay, and resolves it before the guest does. • Innovation & Continuous Learning: Stays at the forefront of coaching science and technology, and brings fresh ideas into the academy programme. Resilience & Stamina: Maintains energy, composure and enthusiasm across long coaching days outdoors in the Saudi climate. Education & Experience • Full Member of a recognised PGA (PGA of GB&I, PGA of America Class A, PGA of South Africa, PGA of Australia or equivalent) in good standing — mandatory. • Advanced coaching qualification preferred, such as PGA Advanced Professional Diploma, Master Professional status or a recognised national coaching accreditation. • Minimum of 8 years’ full-time golf instruction experience, including at least 3 years in a senior, lead or head teaching role at a luxury resort, private club or premium golf academy. • Demonstrable record of developing elite junior or amateur players, alongside high-volume coaching of beginners and recreational golfers. • Experience of mentoring and leading a

a2f500637edb5b39.description: Job Purpose HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Risk Manager to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will spearhead the program-wide risk management framework and mitigation strategies for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity. You will be providing program-level leadership, governance, coordination, and strategic risk oversight for all risk and opportunity management activities across the program, ensuring that risk identification, assessment, mitigation tracking, and reporting are fully integrated into planning, project controls, design, construction, and interface management to facilitate informed decision-making for PMCM Management and the Client, while supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program. Reports To Program Director Key Responsibilities Risk Management Governance Establish and maintain the Program Risk Management Framework, Risk Management Plan, procedures, standards, methodologies, and reporting requirements. Ensure consistent implementation of risk management requirements across all program packages. Promote a proactive risk management culture throughout the program. Ensure alignment of risk management activities with program objectives and delivery strategies. Risk Identification and Assessment Lead program-wide risk identification activities and structured risk workshops. Facilitate identification of strategic, technical, commercial, schedule, cost, interface, quality, HSE, stakeholder, and regulatory risks. Support development and maintenance of package and program risk registers. Assess probability, impact, exposure, and criticality of identified risks and opportunities. Ensure consistent application of risk assessment methodologies. Risk Mitigation and Monitoring Coordinate development of risk mitigation, response, contingency, and monitoring plans. Monitor implementation and effectiveness of agreed mitigation actions. Track emerging risks, changes in risk exposure, and residual risks. Escalate significant risks affecting program objectives, milestones, budgets, approvals, or delivery commitments. Monitor risk ownership and accountability. Program Risk Integration Coordinate with the Planning & Scheduling Manager regarding schedule-related risks and mitigation measures. Coordinate with the Project Control Manager regarding cost, performance, and forecasting risks. Coordinate with the Senior Commercial Manager regarding contractual, commercial, claims, and procurement risks. Coordinate with the Interface Manager regarding interface, utility, authority, and stakeholder risks. Coordinate with the Technical Manager and Design Manager regarding technical, engineering, and design risks. Coordinate with the Quality Manager and HSE Manager regarding quality, safety, and environmental risks. Risk Analysis and Reporting Lead qualitative and quantitative risk analysis activities where required. Monitor program risk exposure and risk trends. Prepare risk reports, dashboards, executive summaries, and management presentations. Provide risk-based recommendations to PMCM Management and RCRC. Maintain program risk registers and associated risk management documentation. Opportunities Management Promote identification and assessment of opportunities that may improve cost, schedule, quality, operational performance, sustainability, or delivery outcomes. Monitor implementation of approved opportunity initiatives. Assess potential benefits and associated risks of proposed opportunities. Workshops and Stakeholder Coordination Facilitate risk workshops, risk review meetings, lessons learned sessions, and stakeholder coordination meetings. Support integration of risk management into program governance and decision-making processes. Coordinate with Lead Developers and stakeholders regarding significant program risks and mitigation strategies. General Responsibilities Promote continuous improvement in risk management practices. Support implementation of PMIS, risk management software, dashboards, and reporting systems. Support lessons learned and knowledge management initiatives. Perform related duties as assigned by Management. Maintain compliance with Company policies, procedures, and applicable regulations. Education & Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Membership of a recognized Chartered Professional Institution relevant to the discipline or approved equivalent. More than fifteen (15) years of professional experience. Demonstrated experience in enterprise risk management, project risk management, infrastructure delivery, urban development, major capital projects, or mega-programs. Experience in PMCM, PMC, EPCM, consultancy, developer, contractor, or client-side organizations. Experience within Saudi Arabia and/or GCC region is preferred. Technical Skills Enterprise Risk Management Project Risk Management Risk Identification and Assessment Risk Register Development and Management Qualitative Risk Analysis Quantitative Risk Analysis Risk Mitigation Planning Opportunity Management Program Governance Schedule and Cost Risk Analysis Monte Carlo Analysis (Preferred) Commercial and Contractual Risk Assessment Technical and Interface Risk Management Risk Reporting and Dashboard Development PMIS and Risk Management Systems Workshop Facilitation Core Competencies Enterprise & Project Risk Management Risk Governance & Risk Register Management Qualitative & Quantitative Risk Analysis Schedule & Cost Risk Assessment Commercial, Contractual & Technical Risk Management Interface & Stakeholder Risk Management Opportunity Management Risk Reporting & Executive Dashboards PMIS & Risk Management Systems Workshop Facilitation, Leadership, Strategic Thinking, Communication, and Problem Solving

a24ef02d8fda7fe7.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
a24ef02d8fda7fe7.description: About the Role King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is seeking a Career Development & Internship Lead. This full-time position provides career counseling, professional development, and internship support to KAUST students, guiding them in identifying and pursuing career pathways aligned with their skills, interests, academic backgrounds, and professional goals. The role involves direct, student-centered career advising across KAUST's graduate and academic programs, preparing students for employment and further professional opportunities. Key Responsibilities The Career Development & Internship Lead will play a central role in supporting students' professional journeys and expanding internship opportunities. This includes working under the direction of the Head, Career Development & Industry Partnerships, engaging with employers, and facilitating student-employer connections. Provide individualized career counseling and advising to students, helping them identify career interests, goals, strengths, and potential pathways. Conduct one-on-one sessions covering career exploration, job search strategies, CV/resume development, cover letters, interviewing, networking, professional branding, and employment preparation. Help students translate academic, research, technical, and transferable skills into competencies valued by employers. Support students in developing individualized career plans and identifying professional development, networking, internship, and employment opportunities. Advise students on career pathways across industry, academia, entrepreneurship, government, and other professional sectors. Provide targeted career support for internships, job searches, interviews, career fairs, and employer engagement activities. Develop resources and tools to assist students in navigating career exploration and employment processes independently. Maintain records of student advising activity and utilize feedback to enhance career services. Internship Program Development A significant aspect of this role involves the development and expansion of high-quality internship opportunities for KAUST students, both in Saudi Arabia and internationally. This requires proactive engagement with external organizations and close coordination with academic divisions. Identify potential internship hosts through employer outreach, professional networks, and alumni connections. Develop and maintain a working database of internship opportunities and employer contacts. Engage with prospective internship hosts to understand their talent needs, requirements, and timelines. Match students with relevant internship opportunities based on their academic background, skills, and career interests. Coordinate with faculty and academic divisions to ensure internships align with students' academic and professional development. Support students throughout the internship process, from opportunity identification and application to placement and completion. Help establish and maintain processes for documenting internship placements, student participation, employer feedback, and outcomes. Monitor the quality and effectiveness of internship experiences and identify areas for improvement. Build relationships with successful internship hosts to encourage repeat placements and expanded opportunities. Collaboration and Support The Career Development & Internship Lead will work collaboratively with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure students receive comprehensive career support and access to meaningful experiential learning opportunities. This includes close interaction with academic divisions, faculty, student services, alumni, and graduate employment colleagues. Work Type This is a full-time position within King Abdullah University of Science and Technology.

a258c4b3b70ea26c.description: About the Role Honeywell International Inc. is seeking a Senior Program Controls Specialist to lead and govern program controls across a portfolio of large, complex projects. This full-time role, open to Saudi Nationals only, provides strategic oversight for successful project delivery and strong financial performance, encompassing cost management, scheduling, forecasting, risk management, performance reporting, change control, and portfolio analytics. The position requires over 10 years of experience. Role Context and Impact The Senior Program Controls Specialist acts as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, project directors, finance, commercial, procurement, and delivery teams. This role drives data-informed decision-making, forecasting accuracy, governance compliance, and continuous improvement within the project controls function. The specialist leads cross-functional teams, establishes controls frameworks, and ensures alignment between project execution, business objectives, client requirements, and organizational standards. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of program controls frameworks, methodologies, policies, and governance processes across multiple projects and programs. Provide strategic oversight of project budgets, forecasts, schedules, cash flow, earned value performance, and key project performance indicators. Direct portfolio-wide cost and schedule forecasting activities, ensuring accuracy, consistency, transparency, and timely reporting to senior leadership. Establish, approve, and maintain program and project baselines, ensuring effective measurement of scope, schedule, cost, progress, and performance. Lead monthly business reviews and executive reporting, including variance analysis, trend assessment, scenario evaluation, and actionable recommendations. Drive the analysis and resolution of critical project risks, schedule delays, cost overruns, productivity challenges, and execution issues. Partner with Project Directors, Program Managers, Commercial, Finance, Procurement, and Delivery teams to optimize project outcomes and financial performance. Provide executive-level dashboards and strategic insights using Power BI, SAP, Primavera P6, Microsoft Excel, and other enterprise project controls systems. Lead change management and change control governance, including evaluation of cost, schedule, contractual, risk, and business impacts. Oversee project controls personnel and provide direction, coaching, mentoring, performance management, and capability development. Ensure project controls processes comply with corporate governance requirements, client obligations, audit expectations, and industry best practices. Direct portfolio-level risk management, mitigation planning, contingency management, and escalation of material exposures. Support business planning, resource forecasting, capital planning, and long-range portfolio performance analysis. Establish standards and best practices that improve forecasting accuracy, reporting quality, data integrity, and operational efficiency. Lead audits, compliance reviews, lessons learned, assurance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives. Act as the primary program controls focal point for executive leadership, customers, auditors, and other key stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in program controls or a related field. Demonstrated experience in leading and governing program controls across complex projects. Proficiency with enterprise project controls systems such as Power BI, SAP, Primavera P6, and Microsoft Excel. Strong analytical skills for variance analysis, trend assessment, and scenario evaluation. Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams including Project Directors, Program Managers, Commercial, Finance, Procurement, and Delivery teams. About Honeywell International Inc. Honeywell Technologies is a global automation company focused on solving mission-critical challenges and enhancing quality of life. The company serves the building, industrial, and process sectors with a portfolio of services, solutions, and products, supported by its Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. Honeywell leverages the expertise of its more than 50,000 employees and decades of data to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy. Career Development Honeywell offers a culture that fosters inclusion, diversity, and innovation. The company provides market-specific training and ongoing personal development opportunities for its employees.

a22ff8669b31eb13.description: About the Role Red Sea Global is seeking an Instructor – Water Sport to join their team in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves delivering safe, engaging, and high-quality watersports experiences across The Red Sea destination. The Instructor will operate under the guidance of the Senior Instructor – Water Sports and Watersports Management, providing professional instruction and supervising guests during activities. Company Overview Red Sea Sports & Entertainment Company (RSSE), a wholly owned subsidiary of Red Sea Global (RSG), focuses on creating, operating, and delivering world-class land and marine experiences within The Red Sea destination. RSSE's portfolio includes Galaxea for marine adventures, AKUN for land-based adventure experiences, and WAMA for leisure and recreational activities. As a strategic partner of the Saudi Olympic & Paralympic Committee, RSSE promotes inclusive and accessible sports and recreational experiences, supporting Saudi Vision 2030 by positioning The Red Sea as a leading global destination for regenerative tourism and premium leisure. Key Responsibilities Deliver guided watersports activities in accordance with approved operating procedures and RSSE service standards. Conduct guest welcome sessions, safety briefings, and equipment demonstrations. Supervise guests during activities, ensuring safety and adherence to guidelines. Assess guest ability, weather, sea conditions, tides, and operational risks. Provide professional instruction, coaching, and guidance tailored to guests' experience levels. Inspect, prepare, clean, maintain, and store watersports equipment. Conduct routine equipment inspections and report maintenance requirements or defects. Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Risk Assessments, and Emergency Response Plans. Monitor environmental conditions and respond effectively to emergencies, providing first aid if required. Work collaboratively with the Watersports Operations team and participate in training sessions and drills. Comply with all RSSE policies, procedures, and complete activity reports and documentation accurately. Apply Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental (HSQE) policies and support marine conservation initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant watersports instruction role. Demonstrated professionalism, reliability, and ownership of responsibilities. Ability to create safe, enjoyable, and memorable watersports experiences. Proficiency in delivering watersports instruction using recognized techniques and applying risk management principles. Capability to assess environmental conditions and guest capability. Competence in operating equipment safely and efficiently. Ability to respond confidently to incidents and emergency situations. Work Environment The Instructor – Water Sports operates within a luxury marine recreation environment at The Red Sea destination. The role emphasizes guest safety, exceptional service, operational excellence, and environmental sustainability. This position is integral to WAMA's watersports programme, ensuring high standards of professionalism and guest satisfaction. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process. Candidates are encouraged to maintain professional competency through ongoing training and certification renewal, staying current with watersports techniques and industry best practices.

a279529d972379bb.description: استقبال العملاء والترحيب بهم وتوجيههم إلى الطاولات. تقديم قوائم الطعام وشرح الأصناف والعروض المتاحة للعملاء. استقبال طلبات العملاء والتأكد من تسجيلها بشكل صحيح. تقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات للعملاء وفق معايير الخدمة المعتمدة. التأكد من مطابقة الطلبات المقدمة لطلبات العملاء. لالتزام بمعايير النظافة الشخصية وسلامة الأغذية. التعامل مع شكاوى العملاء بطريقة مهنية وإحالتها إلى المشرف عند الحاجة. التعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سير العمليات التشغيلية بكفاءة. الالتزام بتعليمات الإدارة والمشرف المباشر والأنظمة المعمول بها.

This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management expertise, hands-on experience in software testing and quality assurance, and a solid understanding of banking systems and processes. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage end-to-end banking technology projects, ensuring timely delivery within defined scope, budget, and quality standards. Oversee testing activities, including test planning, execution, defect management, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, development teams, QA teams, and vendors. Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, resource allocation, and risk management strategies. Ensure effective implementation of testing methodologies and quality assurance best practices. Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and implement appropriate mitigation strategies. Manage stakeholder communication, project reporting, and escalation processes. a22c6484dabbea84.description: Shipa Delivery is an online platform that makes it easier for businesses and consumers to send and receive parcels within the GCC. Our expanding operation connects users with a network of delivery assets and services via mobile apps and online business dashboards. We make collection of packages within one hour a reality, along with a choice of on-demand, same-day, next-day, and cross-border delivery services. Shipa Delivery’s technology stack provides real-time parcel tracking via GPS; and for businesses, an integrated solution to streamline last-mile logistics and automate delivery management. We celebrate versatile and self-driven candidates. We need you to be obsessed with customer engagement and be a force of evolution to make us better every day. Our culture is all about speed and care. Role Summary: The primary role of the Customs Clearance Specialist is you will manage the customs documentation and compliance processes for international shipments. You will coordinate with customs authorities, carriers, and other parties to ensure timely clearance of goods, minimizing delays and ensuring all necessary paperwork is properly completed. You will also stay updated on customs regulations and trade laws to ensure the business remains compliant with local and international trade rules. Responsibilities include but not limited to: · Customs Documentation: Prepare and process all customs documentation, including import/export declarations, commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other relevant paperwork. · Compliance: Ensure compliance with all applicable customs laws, regulations, and trade agreements, as well as company policies. · Customs Clearance Process: Submit customs declarations to customs authorities and ensure timely clearance of goods to avoid delays or fines. · Liaison with Customs Authorities: Act as the primary point of contact between customs authorities, shipping companies, and the company to resolve any customs issues or discrepancies. · Tariff Classification & Duties: Calculate and verify customs duties, tariffs, and taxes, ensuring accuracy and minimizing costs. · Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all customs documents and transactions. · Problem Resolution: Address and resolve any issues or delays related to customs clearance, including working with customs brokers or third-party service providers. · Consultation & Advice: Provide guidance to internal teams or clients regarding import/export regulations, classification of goods, and documentation requirements. Risk Management: Identify potential risks in the customs clearance process, such as non-compliance or delays, and take proactive measures to mitigate these risks. Your Qualifications Bachelor’s degree preferably in logistics and supply chain management Minimum 4 years of Customs Clearance or Cross Border experience required. Experience in or exposure to logistics and ecommerce, preferred. Your Proficiencies Team Player, strong interpersonal skills. Work well under pressure in a fast-paced and professional environment. Strong analytical and technical skills Knowledge in strategic planning Flexibility and willingness to do physical work and rotational shifts

a263c42f2e01cc50.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شمس التعافي للخدمات الطبية عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في وادي الدواسر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، ووضع المعايير والإجراءات لضمان رضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي خدمة العملاء مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة، وتشمل: إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة لخدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، ومتابعة تطبيقها. المشاركة في تطوير وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل التواصل معهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات مبتكرة لتعزيز جودة واحترافية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف تجاوز توقعات العملاء وبناء نموذج متكامل للخدمة. تحليل البيانات والمعلومات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل بيانات رضا العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في شركة شمس التعافي للخدمات الطبية، وتتطلب التواجد في مدينة وادي الدواسر بالرياض. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة شمس التعافي للخدمات الطبية.

a27c0d7b0fa712d7.description: Job description About the job HULL OUTFITTING DESIGNER (CS) We are seeking an experienced Hull Outfitting Designer (Construction Support – CS) for marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing design and technical support to shipyard production teams, resolving hull outfitting-related issues, updating production drawings, and ensuring design accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project specifications and applicable marine standards. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide construction and production support for hull outfitting activities in marine and shipbuilding projects. Prepare, review, and revise hull outfitting design deliverables, including: Hull outfitting arrangement and layout drawings Deck outfitting arrangements and equipment layouts Ladders, platforms, walkways, handrails, and access arrangements Doors, hatches, manholes, and other hull outfitting components Foundations, supports, brackets, and equipment seating arrangements Mooring, anchoring, and deck equipment arrangements, where applicable Production, fabrication, and installation drawings 2D drawings and 3D models for hull outfitting components Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams for hull outfitting fabrication, assembly, and installation activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), drawing discrepancies, and production-related design issues. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper design integration and avoid clashes. Verify the compatibility of outfitting components with hull structures, deck arrangements, access requirements, and installation constraints. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation related to hull outfitting components. Ensure design deliverables comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, classification requirements, and shipyard construction practices. Support constructability reviews and identify potential fabrication, installation, and access-related issues before execution. Maintain updated production drawings, design records, and technical documentation in accordance with project procedures. Coordinate with engineering teams, vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of design issues. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications, where required. Ensure design deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in hull outfitting design within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and production drawing modifications. Strong experience in hull outfitting arrangements, deck equipment layouts, access systems, platforms, ladders, handrails, doors, hatches, and associated components. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting , or other shipbuilding CAD software accepted by the client. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, fabrication drawings, and installation drawings. Good understanding of hull structure interfaces, outfitting component installation, fabrication practices, and shipyard production requirements. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, shop drawings, technical specifications, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during fabrication and installation activities. Familiarity with marine classification requirements, applicable shipbuilding standards, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. VERTICAL ENGINEERING Preferred candidate Years of experience 2+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

a21c6c0b87ab9330.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير مستودع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير المستودع الإشراف المباشر على جميع أعمال إدارة المستودعات، بما في ذلك التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لدعم العمليات اليومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تخطيط وتنظيم أعمال المستودعات ومراقبة المخزون، ومتابعة تنفيذ العمليات المختلفة. المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية الخاصة بالتموين والتوزيع. ضمان تطبيق أفضل الممارسات والمعايير المتعلقة بإدارة المستودعات وضبط المخزون. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة القانونية والفنية المتعلقة بإدارة المخازن وتوفير بيئة تخزين مناسبة للحفاظ على الموجودات ومنع تلفها أو استخدامها غير المصرح به. الإشراف على تنظيم وترتيب المواد في المخازن وضمان ترميزها ووضع تاريخ الوصول عليها. التأكد من أن عمليات التخزين تتم بالشكل الصحيح للمواد داخل المستودعات بما يضمن سلامتها ويمنع فقدانها أو تلفها. الإشراف على وثائق وسجلات الجرد والصرف ومتابعتها والتأكد من سلامتها. إعداد المقترحات والأنظمة التي تهدف إلى تبسيط العمل والوصول إلى نتائج أفضل. إعداد التقارير التشغيلية الدورية عن المستودعات والمواد الموجودة فيها. تحديد مشكلات وتحديات العمل واقتراح الحلول والإجراءات الوقائية والتحسينية المناسبة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات في مجال إدارة المستودعات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على الإشراف المباشر على العمليات التشغيلية والإدارية. معرفة جيدة بممارسات ومعايير إدارة المخزون والسلامة في المستودعات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة في إدارة المستودعات. عن شركة معين للموارد البشرية شركة معين للموارد البشرية هي شركة رائدة في مجال توفير الكفاءات والحلول البشرية، ملتزمة بدعم نمو الأعمال من خلال توفير المواهب المناسبة لمختلف القطاعات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

a240d6442d301d3a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدكان عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة عمليات الشراء المختلفة، بدءًا من تحديد الاحتياجات وحتى استلام المواد ومطابقة المواصفات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في سلاسة العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طلبات الشراء الواردة من الجهات المعنية وتدقيقها لضمان توافقها مع اللوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. تنفيذ عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع وفقًا للوائح التنظيمية المعتمدة. تجهيز وثائق المناقصات وتوزيعها، وجمع عروض التوريد، وتشكيل فرق لدراسة العروض ومتابعتها. تدقيق نتائج دراسة العروض وإرساء طلب الشراء على العرض الأنسب بما يتوافق مع اللوائح والتنظيمات. متابعة استلام المشتريات والتأكد من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان دقتها وامتثالها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المشتريات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالمشتريات. مهارات جيدة في التدقيق والمتابعة لضمان دقة العمليات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديمها بوضوح. مهارات التواصل الفعال مع الموردين والجهات الداخلية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق يدعم عمليات المشتريات لضمان توفير المواد والسلع بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.
